# Nutrition

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

The nutrient content (e.g. calories, carbohydrates, fat, fiber) associated with a meal, recipe, or ingredient.

## Scope note

Data parsed from recipe sources (PTE, DMP) in PKMMeals; used for tracking and analysis such as carbohydrate totals shown on recipe cards.

## Broader

- [Recipe](../Recipe/) — partitive (ISO 25964)
